title: Fine-Tuning LLMs: From Zero to a Shipped Adapter
description: Everything you need to actually fine-tune a model and know whether it worked. Covers the decision framework (when fine-tuning beats prompting or RAG), the complete terminology map, LoRA and QLoRA mechanics, dataset construction, a full walkthrough of the self-hosted Unsloth track and the managed Azure AI Foundry track, real published cost figures and a ranked cost-mitigation playbook, evaluation and failure diagnosis, and how to merge, quantise and serve what you trained.
